drafting_method: Pass 1 drafted by Qwen 3.5 (not a route C model) under owner decision A; pass 2 by the owner, every value checked against the image. Weaker evidence than independent human transcription.
anchoring_note: The owner confirmed every drafted value without a correction. Agreement with the draft cannot rule out anchoring on it: a value the owner accepted because the draft showed it would look the same.
parentage_note: The review page showed printed values, headers and serving lines, not parent rows, so parentage is structural: a draft parent naming the row itself or a row absent from the table is cleared.
nutrient_key_note: Nutrient keys were not on the review page either. A key the draft left unrecognised for a label whose Traditional Chinese part is exactly one closed Taiwan row name (for example 鈉 in 'Sodium/鈉') is mapped by the agent's mechanical check and listed per record under review.mechanical_nutrient_mappings; it is not owner-verified.
unit_note: A value printed without a unit (for example 熱量 '100' on a US-style bilingual label) is kept exactly as printed in unscored_cells and is ungradable; no unit is inferred.
review_rounds: Round 1 (17 October 2026): 40 photos, 527 of 527 cells confirmed, 11 exclusions agreed, order 23 excluded, order 34 kept. Round 2 (17 October 2026): order 34 (redrafted with the bilingual instruction v1.2) and refills 63 to 77, 268 of 268 cells confirmed with no corrections, refill exclusions 66, 71 and 75 agreed. The owner confirmed order 34's printed values as drafted, including 熱量 '100' with no unit.
